name: Google Business Profile suspension evidence-pack reinstatement
buyer: Locksmiths, plumbers, towing firms and other local service businesses whose Google Maps listing was suspended
pain: The listing vanishes from Search and Maps overnight, cutting off calls. The free appeal form is confusing and the evidence requirements are unclear.
wedge: A $149 flat evidence-pack generator for the most common suspension causes, aiming to cut owner time per case to under 30 minutes. The researcher honestly describes this wedge as thin.

scan1Edge.entrant_basis: A templated evidence pack built with AI tools keeps per-case labor low enough to price at $149 flat.
scan1Edge.falsifier: If a templated pack does not get listings reinstated (Google rejects it) or Fiverr gigs at around $100 already satisfy buyers, the $149 price has no edge.

unitEconomicsNoted.notes: The researcher estimates 60-80% margin when cases succeed. Failed cases and refunds erode it. Pay-on-success terms would mean unpaid labor.

majorUncertainty: Whether a templated evidence pack actually produces reinstatements, and whether an unknown entrant with no case history or reviews can earn trust.
unknowns: The platform-change risk is stated in the notes but not supported by an excerpt
Whether buyers will pay $149 versus pay-on-success competitors
Customer acquisition channel for suspended-listing owners
Whether the vendor success claims (295/300, 2,000+) are accurate
regulatoryOrPlatformDependency: Fully dependent on Google's appeal flow and policies, which can change at any time. Requires the client to grant Business Profile access.
